title: A NOVEL RING CLEAVAGE OF 2,4,6-CYCLOOCTATRIEN-1-ONE
abstract: Abstract                Piperidine reacts with 2,4,6-cyclooctatrien-1-one(1) to give 8-piperidino-3,5,7-octatrien-2-one and acetophenone. When pyrrolidine and morpholine were used the corresponding 8-amino ketones were produced. Deuterium insertion study of 1 with N-deuteriopiperidine suggests that in DMSO the ring cleavage proceeds by initial addition of piperidine at the C(7) and C(2) carbons (2,7-addition) followed by subsequent fission of C(7)–C(8) bond of 1.
